active.name: Efficient Solar Arrays Mk II
active.description: Multi-junction cells and better thermal management raise solar array output.
active.limitation: Panels still degrade with micrometeoroid damage.

active.name: Expanded Battery Bank
active.description: Additional lithium-sulfur modules for the station power bus.
active.limitation: More stored energy does not raise generation.

active.name: Closed-loop Water Recovery Mk II
active.description: Improved distillation and filtration recover more water from humidity and waste.
active.limitation: Requires a well-maintained life-support system.

active.name: Hydroponic Bay
active.description: A small crop bay supplements stored rations with fresh produce and improves morale.
active.effectText: +3 kg food per day, +4 morale target
active.limitation: Supplements, but does not replace, supply convoys.

active.name: Adaptive Optics Package
active.description: Deformable mirror segments correct small wavefront errors.
active.limitation: No effect on radio observations.

active.name: Cryogenic Receiver Upgrade
active.description: Lower receiver noise temperature for the radio dish.
active.limitation: No effect on optical observations.

active.name: Automated Data Pipeline
active.description: Automated calibration and reduction speed up scientific analysis.
active.limitation: Does not improve data quality.

active.name: Stellar classification
active.description: Systematic spectral typing of stars. Unlocks a spectrometer suite for the observatory.
active.effectText: Unlocks the spectrometer suite; +3% optical accuracy
active.limitation: Classification rests on catalogued spectral standards.

active.name: Infrared astronomy
active.description: Cooled detectors for dust-penetrating observations.
active.effectText: Unlocks the infrared telescope and infrared imager
active.limitation: Needs cryogenic cooling, so it is expensive to run.

active.name: Galactic structure
active.description: Maps of spiral arms, bars and halos from stellar surveys.
active.limitation: Models are only as good as the surveyed volume.

active.name: Exoplanet science
active.description: Transit and radial-velocity methods for planets around other stars.
active.limitation: Planets can only be studied through host-star light.

active.name: Cosmology
active.description: Expansion history and large-scale structure.
active.limitation: Large-scale conclusions carry large uncertainties.

active.name: Dark matter research
active.description: Rotation curves, lensing and structure constraints.
active.limitation: The nature of dark matter is an open scientific question.

active.name: Relativity
active.description: General and special relativity applied to observations.
active.limitation: Well tested but the strong-field regime is less constrained.

active.name: Quantum mechanics
active.description: Quantum sensors and detectors.
active.limitation: Applications to instruments, not new cosmology.

active.name: High-energy physics
active.description: Radiation processes in extreme environments.
active.limitation: High-energy detectors are costly and power-hungry.

active.name: Gamma and neutrino physics
active.description: Burst monitoring and solar-interior neutrinos.
active.limitation: Neutrino detection from distant sources is extremely hard.

active.name: Gravitational physics
active.description: Interferometry for ripples in spacetime.
active.effectText: Unlocks the gravitational-wave observatory and sensor
active.limitation: Only the most violent mergers are detectable.

active.name: Organic compounds
active.description: Detecting and classifying organic molecules.
active.limitation: Organic chemistry is common; it is not evidence of life by itself.

active.name: Planetary environments
active.description: Climate, geology and chemistry of other worlds.
active.limitation: Models need ground truth from landings.

active.name: Habitability
active.description: Which conditions can support liquid water and chemistry.
active.limitation: Habitable is not the same as inhabited.

active.name: Biosignatures
active.description: Gas combinations and surface features that may indicate biology.
active.limitation: Biosignatures can have non-biological explanations.

active.name: Advanced materials
active.description: Lighter, tougher hulls and structures.
active.limitation: Cost scales with vessel size.

active.name: Scientific instruments
active.description: Better sensors and calibration standards.
active.limitation: Calibration needs regular servicing.

active.name: Power systems
active.description: High-efficiency power conversion.
active.limitation: Output falls with distance from the Sun.

active.name: Compact fission power
active.description: Small fission reactors for deep-space power.
active.limitation: Requires shielding and regulation.

active.name: Autonomous systems
active.description: Self-guided vehicles that need no crew.
active.limitation: Drones are short-range and light.

active.name: Landing systems
active.description: Guidance and braking for surface touchdowns.
active.limitation: Landings are the riskiest phase of a mission.

active.name: Atmospheric entry
active.description: Heat shields and descent systems for atmospheres.
active.limitation: Probes are lost once they sink too deep.

active.name: Conventional propulsion
active.description: Better engines and mixtures for chemical rockets.
active.limitation: Chemical rockets are fundamentally limited.

active.name: Advanced electric propulsion
active.description: Ion and Hall thrusters.
active.limitation: Low thrust means slow acceleration.

active.name: Nuclear propulsion
active.description: Nuclear thermal rocket concepts.
active.limitation: Regulatory and shielding burden.

active.name: Advanced propulsion research
active.description: Fusion drive concepts and beamed propulsion studies.
active.limitation: Concept stage: theory runs ahead of hardware.

active.name: Modular hulls
active.description: Standard modules for free-flying platforms.
active.limitation: Large platforms are fragile to launch.

active.name: Crew vessel design
active.description: Long-endurance crewed vessels with laboratories.
active.limitation: Large crewed ships are very expensive.

active.name: Radiation shielding
active.description: Protection for crew and electronics.
active.limitation: Shielding adds mass.

active.name: High-gain antennas
active.description: Large dishes for distant spacecraft.
active.limitation: Narrow beams need accurate pointing.

active.name: Deep-space relay
active.description: Relay nodes extend the link.
active.limitation: Relays must be placed and maintained.

active.name: Laser communications
active.description: Optical links with very high data rates.
active.limitation: Needs precise pointing; weather-free in space only.

active.name: Quantum gravity
active.description: Attempts to reconcile quantum theory and gravity.
active.limitation: No accepted theory exists. This is active research, not established science.

active.name: Spacetime topology
active.description: Topological models of spacetime.
active.limitation: Speculative mathematical work with no observational test yet.

active.name: Exotic matter hypotheses
active.description: Negative-energy and exotic-matter hypotheses.
active.limitation: Exotic matter has never been observed. Purely hypothetical.

active.name: Advanced cosmological models
active.description: Inflation, multiverse and cyclic models.
active.limitation: Models compete and some cannot be tested.

active.name: In-space manufacturing
active.description: Additive manufacturing and assembly of structures and spacecraft parts in orbit.
active.effectText: Unlocks the orbital factory and custom spacecraft design
active.limitation: Needs a steady supply of raw materials.

active.name: Resource extraction
active.description: Mining and processing of ice, metals and volatiles on other bodies.
active.limitation: Only works at sites with a completed resource assessment.

active.name: Habitat engineering
active.description: Pressurised, shielded habitats that can be built and expanded on other worlds.
active.limitation: Habitats are expensive and need constant resupply and maintenance.

active.name: Autonomous operations
active.description: Self-managing robotic systems that run facilities with little or no human staff.
active.effectText: Facilities without staff run at 60% output
active.limitation: Autonomous systems still fail without maintenance.

active.name: Interstellar precursor probes
active.description: Light uncrewed probes accelerated to a fraction of light speed toward the nearest stars.
active.effectText: Unlocks interstellar precursor probes (decades of travel)
active.limitation: HYPOTHESIS-LEVEL: the propulsion is not demonstrated. Flight times are decades; data return is delayed by the distance in light-years.
